## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Product page copy for Rooibos Chai (100g tin), Pebblebrook Tea Co., UK.

**Claims:**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| Caffeine-free rooibos | Product fact (ingredients). Rooibos is naturally caffeine-free, and none of the other listed ingredients contain caffeine. |
| Cinnamon, cardamom, ginger, black pepper | Product fact (ingredients), fine as written. |
| Lovely with milk | Serving suggestion and flavour opinion, not a measurable claim. |
| 100g tin | Product fact (size). |

**Regulated claims:** Nothing here touches health, money, legal outcomes, the environment, children or prices. "Caffeine-free" describes the ingredients and makes no wellbeing promise. Don't add things like "calming" or "good for sleep" later without a source.

**House style:** There are no banned words or AI tells, and the copy is short and concrete. The policy has no voice section, so I couldn't score it against the brand voice. It reads plain and clean.

**Disclosure:** This is the brand's own product page. It has no ads, affiliate links, sponsors, gifted products or AI-generated imagery in the text, so no label is needed.

**Fixed:** Nothing needed changing.

**Needs a decision:**
- Confirm the blend is made only from the listed ingredients and nothing else with caffeine, such as green or black tea. If so, "caffeine-free" stands.

**Approver:** The policy doesn't name one, so I need an explicit yes from you on this exact copy before it is published. I haven't recorded any approval.
